scope: Daggerfall, Morrowind, Oblivion, Skyrim named player skill catalogs; Arena has no independently advanced skill list. ESO class/guild/world ability lines are excluded as perks/abilities rather than direct 0-100 skill equivalents.
advancement_note: One qualifying action may advance exactly one selected canonical skill; synonyms and historical umbrella labels are not independently rated. Overlapping specialties cannot stack modifiers on a single roll.

entries.name: One-Handed
entries.description: One-handed weapon attacks.

perks.name: Ready Grip
perks.summary: Draw or shift grip without abandoning a useful action.

perks.name: Flowing Strike
perks.summary: Reposition after landing a one-handed hit.

entries.name: Two-Handed
entries.description: Two-handed weapon attacks.

perks.name: Braced Swing
perks.summary: Maintain control when a foe attempts to disrupt a committed swing.

perks.name: Sweeping Arc
perks.summary: Challenge a second nearby foe after a decisive strike.

entries.name: Long Blade
entries.description: Long swords and other long-bladed weapon techniques, regardless of grip.

perks.name: Measured Guard
perks.summary: Keep a blade between yourself and the last target struck.

perks.name: Binding Steel
perks.summary: Turn a successful blade parry into a tactical opening.

entries.name: Short Blade
entries.description: Daggers, short swords and other compact blades.

perks.name: Close Work
perks.summary: Use short blades effectively while crowded or grappling.

perks.name: Seam Finder
perks.summary: Exploit a distracted opponent's weak protection.

entries.name: Axe
entries.description: Hand axes and great axes, including leverage and chopping.

perks.name: Cleaving Grip
perks.summary: Use an axe for a deliberate hook or object-cutting maneuver.

perks.name: Split Defense
perks.summary: A strong axe hit can compromise a shield or guard.

entries.name: Blunt Weapon
entries.description: Clubs, maces, warhammers and crushing arms.

perks.name: Hammering Blow
perks.summary: Press an opponent who relies on rigid armor.

perks.name: Concussive Hit
perks.summary: A well-placed blunt strike can briefly stagger its target.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Spears, polearms and pointed reach weapons.

perks.name: Set Point
perks.summary: Prepare a spear against an approaching enemy.

perks.name: Controlling Reach
perks.summary: Punish an opponent for closing inside your preferred distance.

entries.name: Hand-to-Hand
entries.description: Unarmed striking, wrestling and close-combat defense.

perks.name: Close Clinch
perks.summary: Improve control of an engaged or grappled opponent.

perks.name: Open-Hand Counter
perks.summary: Counter a committed melee attack with an unarmed technique.

entries.name: Archery
entries.description: Bow and other ranged-weapon aiming; earlier Marksman usages include thrown arms.

perks.name: Steady Draw
perks.summary: Reduce aim disruption caused by a modest movement.

perks.name: Called Flight
perks.summary: Take a deliberate precision shot against partial cover.

entries.name: Block
entries.description: Shield and weapon blocking, including reading incoming attacks.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.summary: Protect an adjacent ally with a well-positioned shield.

perks.name: Turn the Blow
perks.summary: Convert an especially good block into repositioning.

entries.name: Heavy Armor
entries.description: Operating effectively while protected by rigid, weighty armor.

perks.name: Load Bearing
perks.summary: Reduce armor-related encumbrance penalties.

perks.name: Iron Stance
perks.summary: Avoid involuntary movement when braced in heavy armor.

entries.name: Medium Armor
entries.description: Mail, scaled, and midweight protection used effectively.

perks.name: Balanced Harness
perks.summary: Keep mobility while wearing substantial armor.

perks.name: Rolling Guard
perks.summary: Reposition without surrendering your armor advantage.

entries.name: Unarmored
entries.description: Avoiding injury without worn armor.

perks.name: Empty-Hand Guard
perks.summary: Gain defensive options without a shield or armor.

perks.name: Unfettered Step
perks.summary: Evade or escape when unrestricted by armor.

entries.name: Armorer
entries.description: Diagnose, maintain and repair arms and armor.

perks.name: Field Repair
perks.summary: Restore useful function with improvised tools.

perks.name: Master Fitter
perks.summary: Custom-fit equipment to a specific wearer.

entries.name: Smithing
entries.description: Forge and improve metal arms, tools and armor.

perks.name: Tempered Edge
perks.summary: Produce a reliably hardened mundane blade.

perks.name: Masterwork Forge
perks.summary: Craft sophisticated designs from suitable materials.

entries.name: Athletics
entries.description: Sustained physical effort and demanding locomotion.

perks.name: Enduring Pace
perks.summary: Sustain exertion through a long journey.

perks.name: Burst of Effort
perks.summary: Push through strenuous movement in an urgent scene.

entries.name: Running

perks.name: Sure Sprint
perks.summary: Accelerate cleanly on bad terrain.

perks.name: Relentless Pursuit
perks.summary: Maintain speed through a difficult chase.

entries.name: Swimming

perks.name: Strong Stroke

perks.name: Deep Diver

entries.name: Medical

perks.name: Triage
perks.summary: Identify injuries that demand immediate attention.

perks.name: Field Surgeon

perks.name: Soft Landing
perks.summary: Reduce harm from a controlled fall.

perks.name: Unlikely Escape
perks.summary: Find a narrow route through a dangerous space.

entries.name: Jumping

perks.name: Vault
perks.summary: Clear a small obstacle while moving.

perks.name: Impossible Leap

entries.name: Climbing

perks.name: Secure Hold
perks.summary: Avoid losing a grip under minor disruption.

perks.name: Rapid Ascent
perks.summary: Climb challenging terrain under urgent time pressure.

entries.name: Light Armor

perks.name: Silent Fit
perks.summary: Reduce the audible interference of worn armor.

perks.name: Quick Slip

entries.name: Dodging

perks.name: Sidestep

perks.name: Dance Through
perks.summary: Evade without giving up your next movement opportunity.

entries.name: Sneak

perks.name: Shadow Passage

perks.name: Ghost Trail

entries.name: Lockpicking

perks.name: Gentle Touch
perks.summary: Reduce risk of damaging a fragile lock.

perks.name: Patient Mechanism
perks.summary: Work through a complicated lock using its feedback.

entries.name: Security

perks.name: Trap Sense

perks.name: Clean Disarm
perks.summary: Disable a complex mechanism while preserving evidence.

entries.name: Pickpocket

perks.name: Light Fingers
perks.summary: Conceal a small manipulation in an ordinary exchange.

perks.name: Invisible Exchange
perks.summary: Swap or plant an object while attention is elsewhere.

entries.name: Backstabbing

perks.name: Approach Angle

perks.name: Silent Opening

entries.name: Critical Strike
entries.description: Recognizing vulnerable attack angles and timing.

perks.name: Weak Point
perks.summary: Identify a target's exposed anatomy or structure.

perks.name: Decisive Opening
perks.summary: Make an unusually accurate strike especially consequential.

entries.name: Mercantile

perks.name: Fair Appraisal
perks.summary: Identify a suspicious price or hidden trade cost.

perks.name: Market Network

perks.name: Read the Room
perks.summary: Notice a listener's immediate priorities.

perks.name: Careful Appeal
perks.summary: Tailor a consequential argument to an audience.

entries.description: Formal protocol, noble audiences and diplomacy.

perks.name: Courtly Maneuver

entries.name: Streetwise

perks.name: Local Ear
perks.summary: Find useful neighborhood rumors without alarming contacts.

perks.name: Underworld Introduction

perks.name: Measured Change

perks.name: Adaptive Pattern

perks.name: Stable Summons

perks.name: Binding Circle

perks.name: Unbound Movement

perks.name: Careful Extraction

perks.name: Stable Imprint

perks.name: Soulwright

marksman.note: Historically covers bows/crossbows/throwing; archery is the broader proposed Elf-Books ranged label.

blade.note: Oblivion Blade handles sword/dagger weapons across grips; choose the relevant distinct weapon skill, never stack.

blunt.note: Oblivion term Blunt; older Blunt Weapon retained.

stealth.note: Both cover hidden movement and detection avoidance.

speech.note: Skyrim Speech is combined social/bargaining; Elf-Books retains separate Mercantile.

lockpicking_skyrim.note: Same skill, source label clarifier only.
